name: Wellness Project
description: Wellness Project lets agents read and log workouts, nutrition, sleep, body metrics, and wearable data in the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Wellness Project account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize my training volume this week compared with last week.
How has my sleep changed over the last month?
Log today's workout: 5 sets of 5 squats at 100 kg.

apps.name: Wellness Project
apps.description: Workout, nutrition, sleep, and wearable data, over Wellness Project's MCP server with browser sign-in.
